renderers.name: desktop
renderers.description: Silk.NET window plus the OpenGL instanced renderer, using LayoutLab for layout and paint instructions.

text.notes: TrueType pipeline with system-font discovery, fallback chains, glyph atlases and kerning. No complex shaping, bidi reordering or tab expansion.

images.notes: File, data and packed sources; intrinsic sizing, object-fit and a shared cache with CSS backgrounds. SVG is rasterised by the host.

clipping.notes: Per-instance clip rectangles and rounded rectangles are fragment-shader inputs; overflow clipping is applied by layout.

transforms.notes: Affine transforms are per-instance shader inputs; CSS transform values are resolved by LayoutLab.

animations.notes: CSS transitions and keyframe animations run through the style resolver; animated paints refresh at 60 Hz while presentation can run higher.

scrolling.notes: Wheel deltas, smooth scroll, host-painted scrollbars, pointer auto-scroll and optional touch panning.

input.notes: Pointer, keyboard, focus, text editing, clipboard, IME, select popups, context menus, drag and drop, paste and cursor mapping.

drawPrimitives.notes: Rects, rounded rects, borders, ellipses, shadows, glyphs and images share one instanced pipeline; canvas OnDraw and OnContext callbacks run at the host boundary.

media.notes: Audio through SoundFlow and video through LibVLC; media controls are host-painted.

webview.notes: Desktop hosts provide the WebView control surface.

inspector.notes: Built-in inspector can run docked or in its own window; devtools can be disabled to remove its cost.

limitations.notes: OpenGL-only with no software fallback; no complex text shaping or bidi; font and image caches are not evicted; fixed 640x360 video frame upload.

renderers.name: android
renderers.description: Activity-owned GLES 3.0 surface reusing the same DonkehWindow, LayoutLab and GLRenderer pipeline as desktop.

text.notes: Same TrueType pipeline as desktop; density is applied so CSS pixels stay device-independent.

images.notes: Same image cache and decoding path as desktop.

clipping.notes: Same shader-driven clip and layout clipping as desktop.

transforms.notes: Same LayoutLab transform resolution and instanced rendering.

animations.notes: Same animation runtime; frame pacing is VSync with a 60 FPS cap.

scrolling.notes: Touch panning with an eight-pixel slop threshold and axis locking, plus host-painted scrollbars with wider touch targets.

input.notes: Touch maps to pointer events; long press becomes a context menu; focus, text editing and permissions are host-backed.

drawPrimitives.notes: Same instanced renderer and canvas handling as desktop.

media.notes: Uses the shared native media path; Android surface and frame pacing are activity-owned.

webview.notes: Depends on the platform host; verify the Android WebView surface for the target API level.

inspector.notes: Devtools are disabled by default on Android; the inspector is a desktop tool.

limitations.notes: No native title bar, frameless resize or window dragging; MSAA disabled; 60 FPS cap; no inspector path.

renderers.name: web
renderers.description: Blazor WebAssembly bootstrap that mirrors the UILab tree into the real DOM. The browser owns layout, cascade and native controls.

text.notes: Rendered by the browser with native fonts and text layout.

images.notes: Native img elements and browser image handling.

clipping.notes: CSS overflow, border-radius and clip properties are applied by the browser.

transforms.notes: CSS transforms are applied by the browser.

animations.notes: CSS transitions and animations are driven by the browser.

scrolling.notes: Browser scrolling; the host consumes opt-in scroll deltas for handlers.

input.notes: Delegated browser events; focus, caret, selection, IME and native form state stay browser-owned.

drawPrimitives.notes: A native canvas element exists, but C# canvas draw callbacks are not bridged and there is no WebGL interop.

media.notes: Native video and audio elements; opt-in play, pause, ended and timeupdate tracking.

webview.notes: The browser host does not expose a nested WebView surface.

inspector.notes: The inspector is not part of the browser host; use browser devtools.

limitations.notes: No LayoutLab or OpenGL renderer; desktop-specific layout behaviour and the inspector are unavailable; canvas drawing is not bridged.
